focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Primary: claim direction sensitive/itchy scalp ('Anti Juckreiz' in the name, high; 'beruhigend bei juckender und empfindlicher Kopfhaut', moderate). Formula compatible: scalpComfortTarget targeted (CSA via Laureth-9@3 = Polidocanol, Urea@6). Route: comfort routes Laureth-9@3, Urea@6. Reason: 7.2 'explicit sensitive/itchy scalp positioning with targeted'. No competing lengths-care claim (moisture claims concern the scalp).
focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active (moderate): itch/sensitive-scalp product with listed prominent comfort routes; confidence limited by the moderate-graded targeted value.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered and kept. Moisture wording concerns the scalp ('Feuchtigkeitsgehalt der Kopfhaut'), not the lengths; 'Wirkung: Pflege, Feuchtigkeit' is retailer-only (low). Dry scalp is part of scalp_active, not a separate focus value.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: targeted (moderate). selfCheck: Generic (6.11): fingerprint matches the frozen packet; formula properties were judged blind and are unchanged after the reveal; no ingredient, family count or position window assigned the weight band (W-line used only as a payload_lipid gate, none present/material here unless stated); W-line derived as W-LINE states with skipped candidates recorded; all three weight subjudgments present; whyNotNeighborBand specific (W2 where two families); confidences name their limiting factor; N-ALT neighbors follow confidence; projection derived mechanically from final properties (T1/T6/T4, W-LIVE, I1/I3, 13.7 rows); no comparison with earlier values made in-lane.
uncertainties: 'Schuppenflechte' (psoriasis) and 'Neurodermitis' are diagnosed-disease wording, out of scope; not read as an E2 dandruff claim ('Schuppen' as the product's problem). Alternative: stem match on 'Schuppen' -> a dandruff claim that fails S-DANDRUFF (no active); E2a/E2b layer 1 would then absorb bundled comfort wording only in the 'Hautproblem'/'Basispflege' units, the separate headline units would still pass, and claimed_target_not_projected:dandruff would be noted. Projected targets would be unchanged.

Secondary dry vs none: the dry wording shares one unit with the sensitive wording; E2a counts it for both. Alternative reading 'same unit as primary, not distinct' would drop the dry secondary (more conservative).
Menthol cooling is positioned but listed after the E3 point; read strictly as non-prominent (no formal CSA counter-signal cap).
